tools.name: retrieve_evidence
tools.description: Search the whole knowledge base for a research question. Returns an evidence pack: findings, a subgraph and the papers. $0.03. The model writes the answer.

tools.name: check_relation
tools.description: Evidence for, against and null on one relationship between two named things. $0.03. If a name matches several concepts, returns ambiguous_concept and is not billed.

tools.name: explore_concept
tools.description: What is known around one gene, drug or disease: upstream, downstream and associations. $0.03.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: One paper and the findings extracted from it. Does not return the article text. $0.03.

tools.name: resolve_concept
tools.description: Match a name, abbreviation or synonym to standard concepts. Free.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: What the knowledge base currently covers: datasets, concepts and relationships. Free. No arguments.
